verdict.rationale: The probe states that the gov.uk guidance pages "remain the open surface". Verbatim content was retrieved from several gov.uk guidance pages (trade mark registration, patent filing, trade mark search, the IPO organisation page), which suggests they are readable without keys, CAPTCHA or a JS shell. The robots.txt wall applies to the separate trademarks.ipo.gov.uk search application, not the guidance pages. missing for 10: a direct probe of the gov.uk guidance URLs with recorded HTTP status, user agent and no-JS rendering result; independent corroboration that no bot wall exists.
